greeting: The mountain is still. As am I.
The temple opens for the worthy.
dialog.shop_open: I offer training. Techniques. Stillness in motion.
dialog.shop_prompt: Guardian teachings. Defensive arts. Balance techniques.
purchase_success: Good. Return when ready for more.
rumor: The twins understand unity. I study alone. Both paths valid.
The black coat knows too much. Unhealthy. Balance lost.
The flute player has rhythm but no center. Sad.
I trained with monks from Dustbelt. Before the fall.
dialog.quest_hook: My meditation stone was taken. By wind? No. Stolen. To the Crag Thieves. Retrieve it. Learn balance through action.
dialog.quest_active: Crag Thieves. Northern cliffs. Stone is smooth. Black. Heavy.
dialog.quest_complete: My stone. Thank you. You understand now. Stillness requires action to protect. Here. My personal technique.
farewell: The mountain remains. As do I.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning practice. Best time for beginners.
dialog.time_noon: Peak heat. Test of endurance. Of will.

party_reactions.kade: I will definitely not be challenging you to any contests.
party_reactions.twist: You're BIG! Like a mountain! Can I climb you?
party_reactions.renna: The stillness has power. Ancient power.

mini_quest.title: The Guardian's Center
mini_quest.description: Retrieve Hashimoto's stolen meditation stone from the Crag Thieves

stages.hook: Meditation stone was taken. To Crag Thieves. Retrieve it. Learn balance through necessary action.
stages.active: Northern cliffs. Crag Thieves' hideout. Stone is smooth, black, heavy. Personal.
stages.complete: My stone. You understand now. Stillness requires action to protect. Here - my personal technique. Mountain Stance. Master it.
